patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column layouts are frequently used, featuring large, impactful visuals or dynamic text blocks on one side and supporting content on the other.
Dynamic, large-scale typography is a primary visual element, with words cycling or changing within hero and introductory text blocks.
Distinctive, muted color blocks (beige, muted green, soft pink) are used as full-bleed section backgrounds to create clear visual segmentation between content areas.

Content sections reveal with a subtle slide-up or fade-in effect as they enter the viewport, creating a smooth, engaging scroll experience. The initial hero video scrolls out to reveal a large 'UN D' logo before the main content.
Each major content section is introduced with a large, often centered, bold title, followed by a distinct background color and a unique content layout.

technique_notes: Implement a smooth scrolling experience using a library like locomotive-scroll, where content sections animate into view with a subtle slide-up or fade-in as they become visible.
Create a dynamic text animation where specific words within a larger text block cycle or change on a timed loop, enhancing engagement in key introductory sections.

Design a transforming sticky navigation that starts as a larger, full-width header with distinct logo elements, then shrinks and consolidates into a compact, persistent bar with split logo elements upon scrolling down.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold sans-serif display headings (~8-10x body) are used as primary visual elements, complemented by smaller uppercase labels and legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp (predominantly sharp corners on all elements and images, contributing to a clean, modern aesthetic).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous vertical and horizontal spacing, particularly between sections and within the hero, creating a sense of openness and allowing content to breathe).

standout: The site's distinctive use of dynamic, large-scale typography as a primary visual and interactive element, combined with a playful yet sophisticated brand voice and unexpected imagery, sets it apart. The changing words in the hero section and the 'Smoking Kills' image are particularly memorable and contribute to a unique brand personality.
